name: Using Pretrained ML and DL Models
outcome: Run existing ML/DL models on scientific data and interpret predictions.
description: Select and run existing traditional ML and deep learning models on scientific inputs. Examine model documentation, prepare compatible inputs, interpret predictions and record the model and execution environment. Model training is outside scope.
external: Python, numerical data handling and introductory ML concepts from lectures or equivalent study.
learn: Read model documentation and check suitability
Prepare compatible inputs and run pretrained ML/DL inference
Interpret predictions and record model provenance
modules: Running existing ML and DL models
moduleDescriptions: Read model cards, check licensing and choose suitable fixed model artifacts.
Match input shape, type and preprocessing to each model contract.
Load supplied fitted ML and pretrained DL models and run predictions.
Interpret outputs and record model versions, input transformations and settings.
prerequisiteRationale: F01 supplies model-family literacy and limitations; scientific data handling and introductory ML are external competencies.
